name: Mary, and Xmas...
original_name: Mary, and Xmas... -メアリー・アンド・クリスマス-
source: On Christmas Eve, a woman reflects on her beloved late grandmother and Hans Christian Andersen's "The Little Match Girl." Drawn by the sound of a record, she sees something appear before her.
translation: On Christmas Eve, a woman reflects on her beloved late grandmother and Hans Christian Andersen's "The Little Match Girl." Drawn by the sound of a record, she sees something appear before her.
